attribution: Maintainer report derived from the argument hint and strings in the Claude Code 2.1.296 binary; not independently verified runtime evidence.

targets.pr: PR number or URL, fetched with gh

effort.highXhighAndMax: Wider coverage; some findings may be uncertain
effort.subagents: At levels using subagents, about one finder per 150 diff lines, bounded between two and eight
effort.omitted: Reuses the last typed level; persists upstream

flags.fix: Applies findings after review, skipping those judged wrong or not worth fixing, then runs relevant checks
flags.comment: Inline PR comments; general note on GitLab MR; findings plus non-applicability explanation for a non-PR target
flags.maxFindings: Positive integer cap, all lifts the cap, default resets it; selection persists and omission inherits it
flags.position: Flags may precede or follow the target

cloud.restriction: Billed multi-agent cloud review requiring claude.ai access and direct user invocation; Claude cannot launch it
cloud.post: Offers a single PR comment from the user's GitHub account; ignored if server-side posting is disabled
cloud.wrapperPolicy: Reject ultra and cloud posting controls; provide manual guidance only

context.localArguments: Non-level/non-flag argument text is inserted verbatim as Review target, not supplementary notes
context.ultraArguments: Cloud reviewer does not receive extra notes; local session uses them to prioritize returned findings
context.interactive: Session or fork can receive prior conversation context
context.projectInstructions: CLAUDE.md loads normally; AGENTS.md requires an explicit import such as @AGENTS.md
context.wrapperTransport: One stream-JSON user message with wrapper policy and optional context in a preceding text block, canonical slash command in the final text block; no handshake or append-system-prompt

versionPolicy: Diagnostic reference only; no version allowlist or minimum version
